identity: Same-date KB fields and hold score already bound by the single-stock candidate; the backend persists action rows in both roles and no action output changes any saved market or label field.
contexts: Display both no-position and already-holding branches; neither actual holding, profit/loss nor market timing is inferred.

materialized_fields.kb_action_no_position_status: source-state/unknown status of the no-position branch
materialized_fields.kb_action_with_position_status: source-state/unknown status of the holding branch
materialized_fields.kb_action_reasons: JSON array of source-based explanations and unbound conditions
materialized_fields.kb_action_rule_sha256: SHA256 of these exact contract bytes

all_fields: nullable Arrow string; registered A-share symbols carry all six fields, other symbols remain null
held_priority: A confirmed white/yellow down-cross, confirmed brick flip with stop state, or a valid score upper bound below 3 yields sell/exit observation.
A bound brick reduction state or an exactly confirmed score of 3 yields partial-reduction/fly observation; actual holding and profit remain unknown.

A score lower bound of at least 4 with an active rope/MACD/brick risk or an independent original sell yields 持有 with CONFLICTING_OBSERVATIONS; the conflicting risks and unconfirmed fly conditions remain explicit in the stored reasons.
A score lower bound of at least 4 with known non-risk states yields hold observation, subject to the actual-position/profit assumptions of the five-point rule.
Otherwise action is null with UNKNOWN_SCORE_OR_RISK; unknown is not treated as zero or false.
flat_priority: Known negative brick, MACD or explicitly broken/death-cross rope state yields wait/observe even if a B signal is present.
A B1/B2/B3 hit without a known blocker is a buy-signal observation only: market timing and complete buy filters remain unbound.
An unknown B value is pending; three explicit false values support waiting for a buy point.
rope: Compare the actual enum values 牵牛, 金叉, 死叉, 牛绳断; non-empty is not broken. 牛绳断 is a below-yellow state, not a new cross event. An event requires kb_white_cross_down=true.
unknowns: S1/S2/S3 are not substituted by original sell; source conflict and anchor gaps remain UNKNOWN. J>80 is an overbought observation, not a standalone J>90 fly rule.
